approval_statement: I approve these D3 tolerances as operational FAIL thresholds, not validated equivalence margins, and the joint global alpha, the family alpha allocation and the family roles, for this audit. I fixed them before examining any D3 statistic of a confirmatory family on the audited data, and data_examined_before_approval records what was examined before approval.
data_examined_before_approval: Recorded before approval. The canonical Gohr D0 instance this protocol audits (Speck32/64, 5 rounds, input difference (0x0040, 0x0000), 10,000,000/1,000,000/1,000,000 rows) had NOT been generated when this record was drafted, so no statistic of the audited data, including R1's sufficient statistic (its label counts), can have been examined. Disclosed prior observations, all on OTHER data: (1) The legacy Gohr D3 results on an unpersisted 5-round Gohr instance under the legacy method: the distribution-consistency audit with outcome PASS and its underlying statistics (audit/dataset/evidence/d3/d3_gohr_distribution_consistency_10000000_1000000_1000000_5r.json) and the separate DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY report (audit/dataset/evidence/d3/d3_gohr_10000000_1000000_1000000_5r.json), examined by the approver (attested 2026-10-23 for the AutoND D3 protocol) and during protocol development by the protocol drafter. (2) The completed AutoND D3 confirmatory production run (run 3434a362d66c432aba3e41923e279982; AutoND speck3264, 8 rounds; outcome INCONCLUSIVE) with its family counts, bound summaries and an independent statistical review of it prepared during protocol development, examined by the approver and by the protocol drafter. (3) The legacy Gohr D1 certificate (audit/dataset/evidence/d1/d1_gohr_10000000_1000000_1000000_5r.json, SHA-256 cffc1d6416b5bd62fb0a4d19358b87ea297afb1cfdecb8925b5c35bc72c0bdca; outcome PASS) and the Gohr D2 rerun evidence (audit/dataset/evidence/d2_gohr_speck_r6_rerun.json, SHA-256 c8b434c26dd6fee91d4b02447df85a093c7af21371d965778daaacd2cbc09603; outcome INCONCLUSIVE; component statuses DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY and NOT_RUN), each describing its own unpersisted 5-round Gohr instance generated in-run, not the instance this protocol audits. Human approver: before approval, saw these outcome labels only (D1 PASS; D2 INCONCLUSIVE, DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY, NOT_RUN) and did not inspect the underlying records or their statistics; during this protocol review (2026-10-23) the approver was also shown the protocol drafter's written summary of the records' contents (the findings below), not the records themselves. Protocol drafter: inspected the complete underlying records on 2026-10-23, during this protocol review and before approval. D1 records zero exact duplicates, zero cross-partition overlap and zero label conflicts among 10,000,000/1,000,000/1,000,000 rows (generated 2026-09-01). D2 records no failures; three radius-8 near-duplicate warnings (111, 12 and 7 verified neighbours among 20,480 queried rows in train, validation and test) that crossed only the practical gate, against a Monte Carlo null probability estimated as 0 (ratio unbounded); six within/cross pairwise components reported as descriptive only; no flags in the serial-lag or structured-repetition tests; a multivariate detector whose permutation budget could not reach the corrected alpha; and a detection-sensitivity calibration (D2.5) that was not run (generated 2026-10-21). These outcomes were known during protocol development; this protocol was not drafted blind to them. (3b) The Gohr D2 detection-sensitivity calibration (audit/dataset/evidence/d2/calibration/d2_calibration_final_v1.json, SHA-256 8b987a0de9df8ee1f440d1a82e3f7e7eb2e3d45b0c2274efa10fc7ec2939822f; status COMPLETED, 2026-09-14): a synthetic fault-injection calibration on a fresh 100,000-row 5-round Gohr instance (not persisted), run with D2 engine schema 6.4 at commit 95f5fa58; it audits no clean dataset, is separate from the D2 rerun above (engine schema 6.5, whose own calibration slot is NOT_RUN), and does not demonstrably calibrate that rerun's detector. The approver ran this calibration; what the approver examined of its results before this protocol review: the approver opened the calibration JSON or examined its individual per-condition detection rates. During this protocol review (2026-10-23) the approver was shown the protocol drafter's written summary of the artifact (its path, SHA-256, status, scope, engine version and the detection results below), not the artifact itself. Protocol drafter: inspected the complete artifact on 2026-10-23, during protocol development and before approval: of the 25 conditions (near-duplicate injection at radii 1, 2, 4 and 8, and lag-1 copy injection, each at fractions 0.001 to 0.05, 100 trials each), 6 met the 0.95 Wilson-lower-bound detection target; lag-1 copy injection at fractions 0.001 to 0.01 was never detected, and radius-8 injection at fraction 0.001 was detected in 84 of 100 trials. The artifact's realized_exact_radius_fraction metadata reads 0.0 because the engine (inject_near_duplicates, schema 6.4) compares each injected row with the overwritten destination row rather than with its source row; re-running that historical injection function on synthetic data showed every injected row at exactly the stated radius from its source, so the injection and the detection rates are unaffected and only that metadata field is wrong. (4) Method-validity calibration evidence of the AutoND design (synthetic data only) and the pre-data design-resolution figures of this design, which depend only on sample sizes and alphas. (5) The frozen II-4-GOHR-IMPL-V1 accuracy margin from which the thresholds are derived. (6) Approver's review during this protocol review: on 2026-10-23 the approver stated that they had reviewed the D3 design choices and the Gohr D2 calibration findings presented by the protocol drafter during this review. This records the approver's review on that date only; it implies nothing about what the approver examined before this protocol review, which items (3) and (3b) record separately. The thresholds, roles, alpha allocation and global alpha were fixed before the Gohr D0 instance was generated.

tolerance_justification.class_conditional_bit: OPERATIONAL THRESHOLD by design convention: not a mathematical conversion from accuracy to a distributional effect, not a validated practical-equivalence margin, and not a certificate of full-distribution equivalence. Value 2m = 0.02, where m = 0.01 is DESIGN.delta_materiality of II-4-GOHR-IMPL-V1 (audit/implementation/preregistrations/ii4_impl_gohr_v1.py, bound by SHA-256 in the frozen record ii-4-gohr-impl-v1.frozen.json, commit d89590f, 2026-10-13): the equivalence margin on the absolute difference in sealed test accuracy between the reference and an independent Gohr implementation (reference 5-round accuracy 0.9291). Reusing it here is a convention. R2 checks each class-conditional bit marginal against the generator's exact reference 1/2, one bit in one class of one partition at a time: a check of conformity to the generator. It does NOT bound a label shortcut on its own: if the two classes deviate in opposite directions by up to 2m each, a single-bit classifier gains up to 2m; only family D bounds the cross-class difference. A PASS means only that every simultaneous upper bound is at or below 2m.
tolerance_justification.class_ratio: OPERATIONAL THRESHOLD by design convention: not a mathematical conversion from accuracy to a distributional effect, not a validated practical-equivalence margin, and not a certificate of full-distribution equivalence. Value m = 0.01, DESIGN.delta_materiality of II-4-GOHR-IMPL-V1 (audit/implementation/preregistrations/ii4_impl_gohr_v1.py, bound by SHA-256 in the frozen record ii-4-gohr-impl-v1.frozen.json, commit d89590f, 2026-10-13): the equivalence margin on the absolute difference in sealed test accuracy between the reference and an independent Gohr implementation (reference 5-round accuracy 0.9291). Reusing it here is a convention. A partition whose positive ratio is 1/2 + kappa lets a constant classifier gain kappa accuracy, so m caps that gain at the II-4 accuracy margin. R1 is confirmatory: the Gohr instance did not exist when this threshold was fixed. A PASS means only that every simultaneous upper bound is at or below m.
tolerance_justification.cross_class_bit: OPERATIONAL THRESHOLD by design convention: not a mathematical conversion from accuracy to a distributional effect, not a validated practical-equivalence margin, and not a certificate of full-distribution equivalence. Value 2m = 0.02, where m = 0.01 is DESIGN.delta_materiality of II-4-GOHR-IMPL-V1 (audit/implementation/preregistrations/ii4_impl_gohr_v1.py, bound by SHA-256 in the frozen record ii-4-gohr-impl-v1.frozen.json, commit d89590f, 2026-10-13). Reusing it here is a convention. Effect: |P(bit j = 1 | Y=1) - P(bit j = 1 | Y=0)| within one partition. With balanced classes the classifier 'predict 1 iff bit j = 1' has accuracy 1/2 + (p1 - p0)/2, so 2m is the cross-class difference that gives that single-bit classifier an accuracy advantage of m. Single coordinate only: many sub-threshold differences can combine in a classifier that uses several bits, so this does NOT bound the 64-bit model. A PASS means only that every simultaneous upper bound is at or below 2m.
tolerance_justification.pairwise_tvd: OPERATIONAL THRESHOLD by design convention: not a mathematical conversion from accuracy to a distributional effect, not a validated practical-equivalence margin, and not a certificate of full-distribution equivalence. Value m = 0.01, DESIGN.delta_materiality of II-4-GOHR-IMPL-V1 (audit/implementation/preregistrations/ii4_impl_gohr_v1.py, bound by SHA-256 in the frozen record ii-4-gohr-impl-v1.frozen.json, commit d89590f, 2026-10-13). Reusing it here is a convention. Effect: total variation distance between the four-cell joint laws of one feature pair in two partitions (A pooled rows, B Y=1 rows, C Y=0 rows). For any classifier f in [0,1] that uses only that pair, |E_P f - E_Q f| <= TVD, so m caps the split-consistency shift of a pair-restricted classifier. It says nothing about classifiers that use more than two bits, and for A the reading is weaker (class-swapping shifts can cancel in the pooled law). Expected uniform-cell design-resolution illustration (the TVD upper bound when both observed tables equal four cells of probability 1/4, at per-hypothesis alpha 0.005/6/6048; an illustration under the reference scenario, not a bound over all possible tables): A 0.00644 (train vs held-out) to 0.00977 (validation vs test); B/C 0.00911 to 0.01381 at 50% class fractions (0.01456 at 45%). Under the reference scenario, B/C validation-vs-test precision is therefore inadequate for m: the expected-table upper bound exceeds m, and the upper bound is at least one quarter of the summed interval widths for every table (max(x, y) >= (x + y)/2), a width-only floor evaluated numerically at 0.0122 to 0.0154 on a grid of near-uniform tables (cell fractions 0.20 to 0.30, class strata of 450,000 to 550,000 rows), whatever the observed differences. This is not a universal impossibility proof: tables far from the reference law (for example a pair concentrated in one cell) can have much narrower bounds.
